notes.title: Quintus makes his Return
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/ee7106ebac196edc101363c253dedfd2b4c07e5b.png[/img]

We are finally in a position where we can announce the project we have been working on for the past 2 years!

While our publishers were working hard on bringing 'Quintus and the Absent Truth' to consoles, we were in the background creating the sequel!

﻿[previewyoutube=TU1XykAORnQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Titled 'Quintus and the Formidable Curse', this follow up will see our Man/Mouse duo face up against true evil. The game promises to bring back much loved mechanics and visuals of the original game, albeit with superior upgrades, as well as so much new!

The game is to bring back the original mechanic of being able to play as both Man and Mouse, however this part of the game has been completely recreated from the ground...down. As you can now switch to playing as our little Quintus at the press of a button!

Not only this, for this follow up game, Quintus is not the only Mouse around; sewn into the plot, our protagonists are joined by 4 new mice, who are ready to help Quintus and Alan face up against evil!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/82cfb5e3180906d8dcf506f51bda87f22339c9b1.png[/img]

Combat is also a new feature that was not present in the original game - With bigger dangers, Alan must now grab a hold of any weapon he can to defend Quintus and himself

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/c0572d68fca471d8b976641c31976b34007fb1e8.png[/img]

As any good follow up game should have, the Worlds our protagonist travel to are much larger in scale as well, giving our Man and Mouse duo the space to swing their bats and face their foes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/f3e8da37b2753d52b4edc16dec1f0146a2fb38ba.png[/img]

For more information on the sequel, head to the game's steam page, or the official website

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440100/Quintus_and_the_Formidable_Curse]QATFC Steam Page[/url]

[url=https://www.wrecktangles.com/qatfc]QATFC Official Website[/url]

notes.title: Quintus and the Missing Jump
notes.content:
A very small amount of players have had trouble with Chapter Three and it's phantom Jump Button. It seems to be a rare problem for a small number of people, but it was still a problem none the less.

It has been such a hard issue to fix as the problem has never happened to me, and from speaking with Players who have had this issue, there is nothing unusual about their set up.

Sooo. after so much time spent trying to fix this, with no luck, I decided that the only way to move forward with this was to reconfigure the Chapter so that you don't actually need to Jump to complete the level.

I have gone through the Chapter from start to finish making sure that you can play without pressing Jump.

Of course, for the Players that [b]can [/b] Jump, the ability is still in the Chapter for you to use where you see fit.

To the Players with the Jump problem, my apologies it has taken so long to find a resolution, but I hope you can now enjoy the rest of the Chapter and game 🐭

notes.title: Quintus and the Absent Truth - Chapter Four - OUT NOW - FREE
notes.content:
[h2]Quintus and the Absent Truth - Chapter Four: Astray - OUT NOW[/h2]

[h2][b]Not only is Chapter Four Out Now, but it's FREE![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/386d286568dc616da34296e242b141a78ba7e22b.png[/img]

That's right, to thank you for all your support so far on Quintus's journey, Chapter Four is free, if you already own Chapter Two and Three. Simply head to Steam, update the game, and as long as you have Chapters Two and Three installed, Chapter Four will pop up in the menu ready for you to continue this adventure.

Sadly though, this does come with an announcement, Chapter Four will be the final chapter of 'Quintus and the Absent Truth.' After much deliberation I decided that the story that we are telling here, would fit better in Four chapters, rather that dragging it out into Five. You'll understand when you play, it just felt right to finish here.

That doesn't mean the journey is over though, I am currently working on a 'Complete Edition' of this tale, that will come with updated graphics, bug fixes and some very exciting suprises.

More will be announced soon, but for now, enjoy Chapter Four and thank you for all your support thus far 🐭

notes.title: Quintus and the Absent Truth - Chapter Three : Lost is Out Now!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38298158/2f9e122dd853fe2bec279c586ead8ff04260c089.png[/img]

[b]Quintus and the Absent Truth - Chapter Three : Lost is Out Now!![/b]

	A Man and his Mouse, an unusual duo to front a Horror-Adventure game, but in ‘Quintus and the Absent Truth’, nothing is ordinary. With its unique art style, double protagonists, and solid storyline, how can you not fall in love with Quintus?

Chapter Three is the first chapter where the player will solely control our little rodent friend. Of what could be compared to a Mouse Simulator, as we take Quintus through several cracks in time to significant moments in our main protagonist, Alan Shaw’s, timeline. Areas are larger and Puzzles are more complex this time round, but completely compliment Quintus’s size and attributes.

Both Chapter Two and Three are currently up with a 15% discount for Chapter Three's Launch Window.

Enjoy 🐭
